title: When 'I' became 'we'
text: A friend announced 'we are finally going to write a novel'; the co-author was not his wife but AI. The writer, who earns a living writing ads, refuses AI: once 'a storyteller in everyone' meant imagination, now it may mean the power of AI.
use: For 'The process of self-discovery has now been technologically outsourced' (2021) and 'Inspiration for creativity springs from the effort to look for the magical in the mundane' (2023).

title: Work as the democratic bargain
text: Work gives people competence, independence, social standing and a stake in the future; the democratic bargain rests on the expectation that effort can improve one's circumstances.
use: For 'Rise of Artificial Intelligence: the threat of jobless future...' (2019) and 'There can be no social justice without economic prosperity...' (2020).

title: Minerals as the new leverage
text: China's dominance over critical mineral processing, used as leverage in trade tensions, shows that power between nations now flows through batteries and supply chains, not only armies.
use: For 'Technology as the silent factor in international relations' (2020).

title: Clean power, fragile grid
text: Sri Lanka's grid collapsed in October 2026 when rooftop solar inverters disconnected together: clean technology without the systems to support it can turn a small fault into a national blackout.
use: For 'Alternative technologies for a climate change resilient India' (2018).

title: A war far away, a queue at the gas agency
text: When shipping through the Strait of Hormuz stalled in March, Indian families queued for cooking gas and induction cooktops sold out within weeks: a conflict thousands of kilometres away had reached the kitchen.
use: For 'Alternative technologies for a climate change resilient India' (2018) and 'Technology as the silent factor in international relations' (2020).
